subject: compatibility backend player rigid-body producer and remediation

finding.binding: The compatibility backend creates a RigidBody with the same id as each Player entry.
finding.rootCause: The active backend previously cloned the generic RigidBody identity without overriding either rx/ry/rz bounds or hsx/hsy/hsz shape half extents, producing a generic 1/1/1 body in both broadphase and narrowphase state.
finding.remediation: Project-package startup now requires BOX3_PLAYER_BODY_PROFILE, and the selected profile is propagated through handshake, initial PUBLIC state, authoritative player registration, runtime snapshots, and later PUBLIC states before assigning both body field groups.
finding.dimensions: The former generic RigidBody schema identity 1/1/1 is rejected. Historical Player constants and scale usage confirm upright default half extents 0.45/1.1/0.45.

reason: The repair removes accidental schema identities from both broadphase and shape state. Standing dimensions are recovered; server-authoritative crouch and flying shape changes remain unresolved.
